article.headline: Central Connecticut State wins 72-67 over Quinnipiac
article.description: — Raphel Laurent’s 27 points helped Central Connecticut State defeat Quinnipiac 72-67 on Sunday.

article.story: NEW BRITAIN, Conn. -- — Raphel Laurent’s 27 points helped Central Connecticut State defeat Quinnipiac 72-67 on Sunday. Laurent shot 9 of 16 from the field, including 3 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 11 from the line for the Blue Devils (3-2). Ashton Reynolds scored 10 points, going 4 of 5 and 2 of 4 from the free-throw line. Keith Mcknight finished with 20 points and 11 rebounds for the Bobcats (2-3). Tayeshawn Cunningham-Pemberton added 16 points for Quinnipiac. Tai Turnage finished with 10 points and two steals. Up next Central Connecticut State plays VSU-Lyndon at home on Tuesday. Quinnipiac hosts Maine on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
